description: Implementation of media capabilities cache and related functions for Android platform in C++, including codec support, HDR types, and audio output configurations.

classes.name: CodecCapability
classes.description: Base class representing codec capabilities, including secure and tunnel mode support.

classes.name: AudioCodecCapability
classes.description: Derived class for audio codec capabilities, including bitrate support.

classes.name: VideoCodecCapability
classes.description: Derived class for video codec capabilities, including resolution, frame rate, and HDR support.

classes.name: MediaCapabilitiesCache
classes.description: Singleton class managing media capabilities, including codec support, HDR types, and audio configurations.

methods.name: GetConnectorFromAndroidOutputType
methods.description: Maps Android output device types to internal connector enums.

methods.name: EndsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix.

methods.name: ConvertJavaRangeToRange
methods.description: Converts a Java Range object to a C++ Range object.

methods.name: GetIsWidevineSupported
methods.description: Checks if Widevine DRM scheme is supported via JNI.

methods.name: GetIsCbcsSupported
methods.description: Checks if Cbcs scheme is supported via JNI.

methods.name: GetSupportedHdrTypes
methods.description: Retrieves supported HDR transfer types via JNI.

methods.name: GetIsPassthroughSupported
methods.description: Checks if passthrough support is available for a given audio codec.

methods.name: GetAudioConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves audio configuration at a specified index.

methods.name: UpdateMediaCapabilities_Locked
methods.description: Updates cached media capabilities if marked dirty.

methods.name: LoadCodecInfos_Locked
methods.description: Loads codec info from JNI into internal maps.
